Definition: Tamar, the name of three women and a place
BiblicalUsage: Tamar = "palm-tree"; n pr f; 1) widow of Er, the son of Judah; fiancee of Shelah, another son of Judah; wife of Judah and mother of Pharez and Zerah; 2) daughter of David by Maacah, sister of Absalom, and rape victim of Amnon her half brother, another son of David; 3) daughter of Absalom; n pr loc; 4) a place on the southern border of Gad
